sara: Cutoff in ~40m for the hotfix window. PR <https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/7890|#7890> fixes a kv-cache double-free during warmup. We need 2x LGTM before merge — @leo can you give a quick second-eye?
leo: On it, doing a quick skim now, will ping in ~15.
maria: I left comments earlier but I can post a formal LGTM once CI is green. Small nits only.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline for PR #7890 — build: passed, unit-tests: running, e2e: queued.
chang: I can take a 5-min look at the warmup logic, free in ~10.
leo: Quick question — in the warmup handler you changed `kv_cache->free()` to a guarded release, is that only on the error path? can you paste the snippet?
sara: snippet from PR: ```c++
if (kv_cache && kv_cache->initialized()) {
  kv_cache->release();
  kv_cache = nullptr;
}
```
leo: OK that looks safer. Main risk is concurrent access during warmup; did we add the lock? I don't see a mutex in the diff.
maria: There is a follow-up change in the same PR that adds `warmup_mutex` around init/teardown — check warmup.cc lines ~78-95 in the branch.
leo: Cool — LGTM (leaving a short note about adding a clarifying comment). :thumbsup:
maria: LGTM :+1:
sara: Amazing, thanks both. Ops: we'll hold merge until e2e finishes; target merge once e2e passes and queue is clear. /cc @sam
deploy-bot: CI update — unit-tests: passed, e2e: running (est ~8m). Merge queue position: 1.
sam: Noted. I'll watch the queue and ping when we're good to cut.
chang: Quick FYI — I'm going on call in ~20m so I won't be able to revert quickly. Please keep canary window to 15m after merge.
sara: Acknowledged. Can we set canary to 15m post-merge? If rollback needed we'll target a 10m window.
sam: Canary set to 15m in the release config.
deploy-bot: e2e: passed. Merge pre-checks clear. Merging in 30s.

leo: Rebased onto main and pushed. Please re-run checks.
deploy-bot: CI triggered for updated PR #7890 — build: passed, unit-tests: passed, e2e: running.
maria: Re-LGTM after rebase. :white_check_mark:
sam: Looks good to me. Proceeding with merge on green.
deploy-bot: e2e: passed. Merged PR #7890 into main. Deploy started.
sara: Thank you everyone — closing this thread. I'll add a note in the release notes about the warmup fix.
